text.title: C# .NET Core Backend Procedure
text.summary: 7-step procedure to apply the .NET Core service umbrella end-to-end. Each step names the rules from `01-core-rules.xml` it satisfies.

step.name: scaffold-project
step.action: Run `dotnet new webapi -n <Name> -f net8.0`. Replace top-level `Controllers/`, `Services/` with `Features/<Feature>/` folders. Set `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>` and `<TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>`, pin the SDK in `global.json`, and append `public partial class Program { }` to `Program.cs` (`nullable-enabled-warnings-as-errors`, `program-partial-for-webapplicationfactory`).
step.decision-gate: If the csproj still builds with nullability warnings, STOP — the gate is the build, not review.

step.name: register-di-and-problem-details
step.action: In `Program.cs`: register `DbContext` Scoped, service interfaces Scoped (never the concrete class), hosted services via `AddHostedService<T>()`, `AddProblemDetails()`. Bind configuration through `IOptions<T>` with `.ValidateDataAnnotations().ValidateOnStart()` and keep secrets in `dotnet user-secrets` / environment (`constructor-inject-interfaces-only`, `options-validated-on-start`, `secrets-out-of-appsettings`).
step.decision-gate: If any scoped service is referenced from a singleton, STOP and apply `di-lifetimes` rule via `IServiceScopeFactory`.

step.name: add-controllers-and-services
step.action: For each endpoint: add an `[ApiController]` + `[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]` controller in the feature folder, `async Task<ActionResult<T>>` actions returning `CreatedAtAction` on create, `CancellationToken ct = default` as the last param threaded into the service. DTOs are records; no EF entity crosses the service boundary; no `Task.Run` on the request path (`apicontroller-actionresult`, `record-dtos-not-entities`, `no-task-run-in-request-handlers`).
step.decision-gate: Reject any action lacking `CancellationToken` plumbing per `cancellation-token-plumbing` rule.

step.name: add-ef-data-layer
step.action: Add `AppDbContext`, one `IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>` per entity applied via `ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly` (never data annotations), repositories returning `PagedResult<T>` of materialised rows (never `IQueryable`), `AsNoTracking()` on read paths and `AsSplitQuery()` on multi-collection includes, with `SaveChangesAsync()` called only inside the repository (`entity-type-configuration-classes`, `ef-asnotracking-on-reads`, `repository-owns-savechanges`).
step.decision-gate: If a repository returns `IQueryable`, refactor — leaked queries break the contract per `ef-asnotracking-on-reads` rule.

step.name: add-migration
step.action: Run `dotnet ef migrations add <VerbNoun>` in the same change as the entity edit; review destructive operations as SQL via `dotnet ef migrations script` (`migrations-reviewed-and-in-sync`).
step.output: Migration committed alongside the model change
step.decision-gate: If `Migrations/` is out of sync with the model snapshot, fail CI. Never point `dotnet ef database update` at a shared or production database.

step.name: add-tests
step.action: xUnit unit tests mocking the service interface with Moq and asserting the `ActionResult` shape via `Assert.IsType<T>`; integration tests via `IClassFixture<WebApplicationFactory<Program>>` + `factory.CreateClient()` and Testcontainers for the data layer (`moq-interfaces-and-classfixture-tests`).
step.output: Test project per service + green CI

step.name: add-background-service
step.input: Async work spec (queue consumer / scheduled job)
step.action: Implement `BackgroundService` that injects `IServiceScopeFactory`; resolve scoped dependencies via `CreateScope()` per work item; bound any `Channel<T>` with explicit capacity and register it Singleton; drive periodic work with `PeriodicTimer.WaitForNextTickAsync(ct)`, never `Thread.Sleep` or a `Task.Delay` loop (`channel-and-periodictimer-for-background-work`).
step.decision-gate: If the hosted service constructor names a scoped type, fail the review — `scoped-in-singleton` antipattern.
